answer: Each epoch the chain selects one past answer per agent and issues a fresh nonce, forcing live re-derivation; the verifier replays the reasoning against the stored transcript, and any divergence beyond one token flags the identity. A Sybil farmer must then fund live compute for every fake key: replaying 5000 identities costs about 1.2 million tokens and 18 hours of GPU time, a basalt-hard economic ledge no nebula of cheap sockpuppets can quietly cross.
